record.paper_title: Some Open Problems on Multiple Ergodic Averages
record.context_brief: Two-fold recurrence: powers versus commuting maps
record.original_question: Does there exist an integer sequence that is good for 2-recurrence of powers of a single transformation but fails to be good for 2-recurrence of arbitrary commuting transformations?

evidence.quote: Problem 7. Is there a sequence that is good for 2-recurrence of powers but is not good for 2-recurrence of commuting transformations?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup and definitions. Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a probability space. A measure-preserving transformation $T:X\to X$ is a measurable map with $\mu(T^{-1}A)=\mu(A)$ for all $A\in\mathcal{B}$. A strictly increasing sequence $(a_n)_{n\in\mathbb{N}}$ of positive integers is called:

(i) good for 2-recurrence of powers of a single transformation if for every invertible measure-preserving system $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu,T)$ and every $A\in\mathcal{B}$ with $\mu(A)>0$, there exists $n\in\mathbb{N}$ such that
$$\mu(A\cap T^{-a_n}A\cap T^{-2a_n}A)>0;$$

(ii) good for 2-recurrence of commuting transformations if for every probability space $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$, every pair of commuting invertible measure-preserving transformations $S,T:X\to X$, and every $A\in\mathcal{B}$ with $\mu(A)>0$, there exists $n\in\mathbb{N}$ such that
$$\mu(A\cap S^{-a_n}A\cap T^{-a_n}A)>0.$$

Question. Does there exist a sequence $(a_n)$ of positive integers that is good for 2-recurrence of powers of a single transformation but fails to be good for 2-recurrence of commuting transformations?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a list of open problems on multiple ergodic averages and no resolution was located in the search. Related work concerns multiple recurrence and norm convergence for commuting transformations (Chu; Host; Frantzikinakis–Kuca, etc.), but none addresses this specific separation between single-transformation power recurrence and commuting-transformation recurrence. Status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Multiple recurrence for two commuting transformations
status_evidence.snippet: Multiple recurrence of two commuting transformations has been studied as an extension of results for a single transformation
status_evidence.claim: Active line of research; the specific separation problem is not resolved in these works.

status_evidence.title: A good universal weight for multiple recurrence averages with commuting transformations in norm
status_evidence.snippet: sequences appearing in Bourgain's double recurrence result are good universal weights to the multiple recurrence averages with commuting measure-preserving transformations in norm
status_evidence.claim: Related results concern weights/norm convergence, not the precise 2-recurrence separation asked.
